tasks.label: Validate Order Clearance Tracker
tasks.command: npm.cmd install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm.cmd run build }

tasks.label: Validate dependency update
tasks.command: npm.cmd install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm.cmd audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm.cmd run build } }

tasks.label: Check Git installation
tasks.command: Get-Command git.exe -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source; where.exe git; Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; Test-Path 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Git\cmd\git.exe'

tasks.label: Initialize Order Clearance Tracker Git repository
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' -C 'D:\Order Clearance Tracker' init; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' -C 'D:\Order Clearance Tracker' status --short }
